teaser: This issue centers on governance and ethics frameworks for AI in nursing, with four papers proposing lenses or models to guide accountability, oversight, and leadership as AI enters care and management settings. A second thread covers workforce AI literacy, from intern chatbot use to school nurse training to interprofessional simulation. Clinical decision support papers test prediction tools for readmission, sepsis, and delirium, each flagging limited or early-stage evidence. NLP papers examine generative AI attitudes and retrieval-augmented generation, both noting gaps between simulated testing and real clinical use.

themes.name: Early-stage prediction tools needing more validation
Generative AI adoption gaps between testing and practice
